name: section
description: CommentPlugin: A comment section for a node

fields.name: node
fields.label: The node uuid to which the comments are attached

fields.name: language
fields.label: The language of the node to which the comments are attached

fields.name: nodeConfigField
fields.label: Field name in the node reference to copy section settings from

fields.name: allowAnonymous
fields.label: If true, anonymous users can create comments

fields.name: moderatorEmails
fields.label: List of emails of moderators that are notified when a comment needs approval

fields.name: requiresApproval
fields.label: If true, the comment needs to be approved by a moderator before it is displayed in public

fields.name: requiredForAnonymous
fields.label: List of fields that an anonymous user is required to fill in
